:::{#exr-sxx-expand}
#### Expanding the centered sum of squares

Expand the centered sum of squares $S_{xx}$ (@def-centered-sums)
into an expression in terms of $n$, $\sumin \predvar_\iobs^2$ and $\bar{x}$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-sxx-expand}

$$
\begin{aligned}
S_{xx}
&= \sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \bar{x})^2
&& \text{(definition of $S_{xx}$)}\\
&= \sumin \paren{\predvar_\iobs^2 - 2 \bar{x} \predvar_\iobs + \bar{x}^2}
&& \text{(expand the square)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - \sumin 2 \bar{x} \predvar_\iobs + \sumin \bar{x}^2
&& \text{(split the sum)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - 2 \bar{x} \sumin \predvar_\iobs + \sumin \bar{x}^2
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - 2 \bar{x} \sumin \predvar_\iobs + n \bar{x}^2
&& \text{(sum of a constant)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - 2 \bar{x} \cdot n \bar{x} + n \bar{x}^2
&& \text{($\sumin \predvar_\iobs = n \bar{x}$)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - 2 n \bar{x}^2 + n \bar{x}^2
&& \text{(multiply)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - n \bar{x}^2
&& \text{(collect the $\bar{x}^2$ terms)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
